notes: «جميعا عن ابن، عيينة» writes Sufyan once; the editor's gloss «قال أبو بكر حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة» names the same man, so the fuller form is the link (rule 7).
The first أبان بن عثمان (occurrence 1) is a travelling companion in the scene; occurrence 2 is the one asked and answering, a link. Omar who sends to him is in the scene only.
Uthman is the last link: Aban's answer relays his hadith from the Prophet (rule 6).
